Chair, distinguished delegates, it is my pleasure to inform you that the working group on agenda item nine general exchange of views on potential legal models for activities in the exploration, exploitation and utilisation of space resources has completed its work at the present session of the Legal Subcommittee. It is my pleasure to inform you about the progress of the working group. The working group met under the five-year work plan as contained in document A/AC.105/1260 annex II appendix and held four formal and four informal meetings during this session of the legal subcommittee to discuss relevant information and exchange views on the draft set of initial recommended principles for space resource activities. It also held two informal meetings prior to this session of the Legal Subcommittee on 13 and 14 April and will hold one additional informal meeting after this session of the subcommittee on Friday 24 April. The working group agreed to apply a step-by-step approach to the discussions on the draft set of initial recommended principles for space resource activities, covering the preamble, the section on definitions, and the principles in a sequential order. The working group agreed that based on the discussions held at this session, The Chair and the Vice-Chair of the Working Group would prepare an updated set of initial recommended principles for space resource activities in accordance with its work plan that would be published on the dedicated webpage of the Working Group next week. The Working Group also agreed that the Chair and Vice-Chair would prepare a consolidated version of the draft set of initial recommended principles for space resource activities that would be translated in all UN official languages and disseminated in a timely manner to States members of the Committee by early September 2026. The Working Group also agreed on holding up to six intersessional meetings before the 66th session of the Legal Subcommittee, with the first of these scheduled for 24 September 2026, to advance its discussions on the draft set of initial recommended principles for space resource activities towards achieving consensus by 2027. Chair, distinguished delegates, with this overview, it is my pleasure to submit to the subcommittee for its endorsement the report of the working group on legal aspects of space resource activities, contained in documents A/AC.105/C.2/2026/SRA/L.1 as well as ADD.1, which have been adopted by the working group as amended.
